description: This file defines an enumeration `JdbcJavaType` that maps Java types to JDBC types for various database dialects, providing methods for type conversion, SQL formatting, and type identification specific to database operations within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: JdbcJavaType
classes.description: An enum representing Java-to-JDBC type mappings with database dialect-specific customizations and utilities for SQL generation and type conversion.

methods.name: getByTypeName
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate JdbcJavaType enum constant based on database dialect and type name, with optional support check.

methods.name: getDialectType
methods.description: Returns the dialect-specific type details for a given database dialect.

methods.name: toJdbcValue
methods.description: Converts a Java object to its corresponding JDBC value, with optional type validation.

search-terms: enum mapping Java and JDBC types
